decisions.Visual theme & density: Option 2: Playful and colorful with soft, rounded elements (Claymorphism style). Adopted comprehensive ui-ux-pro-max guidelines and persisted as the MASTER design system.
decisions.\"Generating\" state experience: Option 1: Playful skeleton loaders matching the Claymorphism style. (animate-pulse with rounded bubbly shapes). Avoid infinite bouncing.
decisions.Question presentation: Option 1: Card-based approach using Bento grid style (1 question per distinct card/block) with depth.
decisions.Answer reveal behavior: Option 1: Immediate reveal with playful success/error micro-interactions (e.g. green/red flash, soft pop) to provide clear feedback and avoid silent actions.
